notes: Priority policy for the machine-global skill library. Every installed skill is advertised (a
hidden skill is not loadable in this environment, so nothing is hidden); `hot` marks the skills
to reach for first and biases `scripts/skills/match.mjs`. Before a task, match the prompt and
load the winners. Edit `hot` when a workflow changes, then run `pnpm skills:inventory` to
refresh the manifest and routing doc.
